create_map_pytorch_optim_to_deepspeed: create a DeepSpeed CPU optimizer from a PyTorch optimizer, selecting the appropriate DeepSpeed backend
get_active_deepspeed_plugin: retrieve the currently active DeepSpeedPlugin from an Accelerate state object
build_hf_deepspeed_config: build an HfDeepSpeedConfig object from a JSON file or dict and query nested config values like zero stage
wrap_deepspeed_engine: wrap a DeepSpeed engine with DeepSpeedEngineWrapper to integrate backward and gradient norm into a conventional training loop
create_dummy_optimizer: create a DummyOptimizer or DummyScheduler for training loops when optimizer or scheduler config is specified in the DeepSpeed config file
